candidates.explanation: The provider falls back to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is undefined. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider, so every email-registered user is stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then sees provider !== 'email' and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'. The default should be AuthProvidersEnum.email.
Register does not set provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly, so it relies on the faulty default in UsersService.create.

fix.description: Change the default provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email (provider: createUserDto.provider ?? AuthProvidersEnum.email). Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
